info.name: Drupal JSON: Comments Node Pages API

params.name: filter[name][path]
params.description: The dotted field path to filter on, e.g. title, status, uid.name, or field_tags.name for nested relationship fields.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort the results by the given field. Prefix with - for descending order. For example, sort=title for ascending by title or sort=-created for descending by creation date.

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: The maximum number of resources to return in a single page. Used for cursor-based pagination.

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: The number of resources to skip before beginning to return results. Used in combination with page[limit] for pagination.

params.name: include
params.description: A comma-separated list of relationship paths to include in the response. For example, include=uid resolves the author relationship, and include=field_tags includes related taxonomy terms inline.

params.name: fields[node--article]
params.description: Sparse fieldset parameter to limit which attributes are returned, reducing response payload size. Replace node--article with the relevant resource type. Value is a comma-separated list of field names.

items.docs: Retrieves a collection of basic page content nodes. Supports the same query parameters as other JSON:API collection endpoints including filter, sort, page, include, and fields.

params.name: uuid
params.description: The UUID of the entity. JSON:API always uses UUID as the identifier, not the numeric entity ID.

params.name: include
params.description: A comma-separated list of relationship paths to include in the response. For example, include=uid resolves the author relationship, and include=field_tags includes related taxonomy terms inline.

params.name: fields[node--article]
params.description: Sparse fieldset parameter to limit which attributes are returned, reducing response payload size. Replace node--article with the relevant resource type. Value is a comma-separated list of field names.

items.docs: Retrieves a single basic page content node by its UUID. Supports sparse fieldsets and relationship includes.
